source_basis: HSE lung cancer treatment information: https://www2.hse.ie/conditions/lung-cancer/treatment/; site-specific radiation consent remains a separate specialist process.

risks.label: Tiredness
risks.detail: Fatigue can occur during and after radiation treatment.

risks.label: Skin reaction in the treated area
risks.detail: The treated skin can become sore, red or irritated; follow the radiation team’s care advice.

risks.label: Site-specific effects
risks.detail: Effects depend on the planned treatment area. For chest radiation, discuss swallowing difficulty, cough and breathing changes during and after treatment. The radiation team must discuss individual late effects and risks.
